name: ShowCaseGlut – Tabs, Accordion, FAQ, Slider, Carousel, Gallery, Testimonials, Pricing & More
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
ShowCaseGlut puts every common “show it off” element in one plugin with one editor. Pick a module, fill in the content, check the live preview, then add it to any page with its shortcode or the ShowCaseGlut block. No coding needed.

How it works

  1. Go to ShowCaseGlut → Add New and choose a module (Tabs, Accordion, FAQ, Slider, Pricing Tables…).
  2. Use the three editor sections: Content (the items), Settings (layout and behaviour) and Style (colours, spacing, borders).
  3. Watch the live preview (desktop, tablet and phone widths) update as you type.
  4. Click Create, then copy the shortcode or add the ShowCaseGlut block.

Every module has its own list under the ShowCaseGlut menu inside the plugin screens, with search, status filter, duplicate and bulk actions.

The 25 free modules

Content & layout

  • Tabs – any number of tabs with title, icon (font icon or your own image) and rich content; shortcodes work inside tabs. Five ready-made templates (Underline, Pills, Boxed, Default, ZuTab), tabs at the top, bottom, left or right, icons-only menu, content slide animation, full control over fonts, colours (normal / active / hover), padding, borders and corner radius, optional section title, keyboard support and deep links (#tab-2 opens tab 2).
  • Accordion – collapsible panels, one or many open at a time, first item open option, plus/minus or chevron icon on either side, bordered or separated style.
  • FAQ – question and answer pairs with a live search box and FAQPage schema (JSON-LD) for Google rich results.
  • Timeline – events with date, title, text and image; alternating or one-sided layout.
  • Process / Steps – numbered steps, horizontal or vertical, with a connector line.
  • Content Toggle – two labels and two content blocks behind a switch (for example monthly / yearly).
  • Icon List – items with icon, text and optional link in 1–3 columns.
  • Info Boxes – grid of boxes with icon or image, title, text and button; card or plain style.

Sliders & media

  • Slider – slides with background image, heading, text and button; autoplay, loop, arrows, dots, overlay and swipe.
  • Carousel – cards with image, title, text and link; cards per view for desktop, tablet and phone, gap, arrows, dots, autoplay, loop.
  • Logo Carousel – continuous scrolling client logos with links, speed, pause on hover and greyscale until hover.
  • Image Gallery – grid with 1–6 columns, aspect ratio, captions and a lightbox with keyboard and swipe support.
  • Before / After – drag handle to compare two images, with labels and start position.

People & social proof

  • Testimonials – quote, name, role, photo and star rating as a grid or slider.
  • Team Members – photo, name, role, bio and social links (Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, GitHub, email, website).
  • Pricing Tables – plans with price, period, feature list (lines starting with - show as not included), highlighted plan with badge and button.
  • Counters – numbers that count up when scrolled into view, with prefix, suffix, label and icon.
  • Progress Bars – labelled bars with percent and colour that animate into view.

Engagement & marketing

  • Call to Action – heading, text and two buttons on a colour or image background.
  • Countdown Timer – counts down to a date and time, with a message when it finishes.
  • Marquee / Ticker – scrolling text items with optional links, speed, direction and pause on hover.
  • Notice Bar – message with button and icon; visitors can dismiss it and the choice is remembered in their browser.
  • Business Hours – opening times per day, today highlighted, and an “Open now / Closed” badge in your site time zone.

Dynamic content

  • Post Grid – posts, pages or any public post type, filtered by category, in 1–4 columns with image, date, author, excerpt and read-more options.
  • Post Carousel – the same query options shown as a carousel.

Tabs options in detail

  • Tab content: title, font icon or custom image icon, rich content editor.
  • Section title: optional heading above the tabs with a choice of H1–H6 or paragraph tag and its own colour.
  • Templates: Underline, Pills, Boxed, Default (grey tabs) and ZuTab (pointer arrow).
  • Position and alignment: top, bottom, left or right; left, centre, right or full width. Vertical tabs turn into a scrollable row on narrow columns.
  • Menu type: titles with icons, or icons only.
  • Content animation: none, or slide in from top, bottom, left or right (switched off for visitors who prefer reduced motion).
  • Icons: position (left, above or right of the title), size, space to the title, and colours for normal, active and hover.
  • Titles: font family, size, colours and backgrounds for normal, active and hover, padding, space between tabs, border (width, style, colour) and corner radius.
  • Description box: background colour, padding and border.
  • Behaviour: which tab opens first, deep links, keyboard arrows, Home and End.

Settings available for every module

  • Accent colour, text colour and background colour
  • Corner radius and maximum width
  • Extra CSS class
  • Add-on friendly: ShowCaseGlut Pro and other add-ons can add options and markup through documented hooks.

Ways to show a showcase

  • Shortcode per module: [showcaseglut_tabs id="12"], [showcaseglut_accordion id="5"], [showcaseglut_pricing id="8"] and so on. The general form [showcaseglut id="12"] works for any module.
  • Block: the ShowCaseGlut block in the block editor lets you pick a saved showcase.
  • PHP: echo do_shortcode( '[showcaseglut id="12"]' );
  • Works inside page builders that render shortcodes (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and others).

Global settings and modules

  • Modules: turn any module on or off. Modules that are off disappear from Add New and stop rendering.
  • Accent colour: one colour for all showcases (a showcase can override it).
  • Performance: load CSS and JS only on pages that show a showcase (default), or on every page. Images are lazy loaded.

Built to be light and accessible

  • No jQuery and no icon font on the front end. One small CSS file and one small JS file, loaded only where needed.
  • Keyboard support and ARIA roles for tabs, accordions, carousels, the lightbox and toggles.
  • Respects the “reduce motion” setting.
  • Layouts respond to the width of the column they sit in, not only to the screen width.
  • RTL ready and translation ready.

Upgrading from version 1

Tabs and accordions created with ShowCaseGlut 1.x keep working. The old shortcode [showcaseglut type="tab" ids="1,2"] renders them with the new Tabs and Accordion modules, and they stay editable under ShowCaseGlut → Tabs (version 1) and Accordions (version 1).

ShowCaseGlut Pro

ShowCaseGlut Pro is a separate add-on that adds 15 more modules and Pro options for the free ones.

  • Extra modules: Flip Boxes, Filterable Portfolio, Video Gallery, Image Hotspots, Image Accordion, Coverflow Slider, Comparison Table, Trust Badges, Modal / Popup, Off-canvas Panel, Animated Heading, Taxonomy Tabs, WooCommerce Product Carousel, WooCommerce Product Categories, Map / Locations.
  • For every showcase: custom CSS, entrance animation, responsive visibility and JSON import / export.
  • Pro options for free modules: for example hover effects, Ken Burns slides, masonry galleries, load-more buttons, schedules for the notice bar and evergreen countdown timers.

The free plugin does not contain Pro code. Pro modules are only listed (with a Pro badge) on the Modules page.

Privacy

ShowCaseGlut does not track visitors, set cookies or contact external services. The Notice Bar stores a dismissed flag in the visitor’s browser (local storage) so it stays closed. Images, fonts and embeds you add yourself load from wherever you point them.

Source code

The admin screens are built with React and Vite. The readable source is in assets/src, and the build output is in resources. To rebuild: run npm install, then npm run build. The front-end CSS and JS (global-assets/frontend) are not compiled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the showcaseglut folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate ShowCaseGlut.
  3. Go to ShowCaseGlut → Add New and pick a module.
  4. Edit the content, check the live preview and click Create.
  5. Copy the shortcode (for example [showcaseglut_tabs id="12"]) into a page, or add the ShowCaseGlut block and choose the showcase. Each module also has its own list under the ShowCaseGlut menu.

Requirements: WordPress 5.8 or newer and PHP 7.4 or newer.
sections.faq:
Can I turn modules off?

Yes. ShowCaseGlut → Modules has an on/off switch for each module. A module that is off cannot be added and its showcases stop showing.

Does it work with my theme?

Showcases inherit your theme’s fonts and text colour. Colours, corner radius, width, fonts (for tabs) and more can be set per showcase, and the accent colour for all of them in Global Settings.

Does it load files on every page?

No. CSS and JS load only on pages that show a showcase. You can change this in Global Settings → Performance.

Where do I find the shortcode?

In the showcase list and at the top of the editor. Click it to copy. Each module has its own shortcode name, such as [showcaseglut_tabs id="12"]; [showcaseglut id="12"] works for all of them.

How do I make tabs vertical or change the tab look?

Open the showcase, go to Settings and choose a Template and Tabs position (top, bottom, left or right). Colours, fonts, borders and spacing are under Style.

Can I use my own icons in tabs?

Yes. For each tab choose “Custom image” as the icon type and pick an image from the media library, or choose a font icon from the built-in set.

Can I open a specific tab from a link?

Yes. Add #tab-2 to the page URL to open the second tab (turn on “Deep link” in the tab settings).

Does the FAQ module help with Google rich results?

Yes. FAQ showcases output FAQPage structured data (JSON-LD).

Can I show posts from a custom post type?

Yes. Post Grid and Post Carousel can query any public post type, and filter posts by category.

Does it work with page builders and the block editor?

Yes. Use the ShowCaseGlut block, or the shortcode in any shortcode or text widget.

What happens to my showcases if I deactivate the plugin?

They are kept in the database and show again when you reactivate it. Shortcodes print as plain text while it is deactivated.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. The text domain is showcaseglut. Translations can be added through translate.wordpress.org or Loco Translate.

Where do I get support?

Use the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • Tabs: all the options of the WP Tabby plugin are now in the Tabs module: section title, templates (Default and ZuTab added to Underline, Pills and Boxed), tabs at the top, bottom, left or right, icons-only menu, custom image icons, icon position and size, content slide animation, fonts, title and description colours, padding, borders and corner radius.
  • Tabs: fixed a vertical scrollbar that could appear on the tab titles.
  • Admin menu: the WordPress menu now lists only All Showcases, Add New, Modules and Global Settings. Every module is still available from the sidebar inside the ShowCaseGlut screens.

2.0.0

  • Rebuilt from the ground up: 25 modules, live preview editor, a shortcode per module and a block.
  • Tabs and accordions from version 1 keep working: [showcaseglut type="tab" ids="…"] now shows them with the new Tabs and Accordion modules, and they stay editable under ShowCaseGlut → Tabs (version 1) / Accordions (version 1).

1.0.0

  • First release: tabs and accordions.
